testCases.name:
test_geval_requirements[Extract functional requirements-# 2. Functional Requirements

### FR-001
- **Requirement:** The system shall provide the mobile application on Android and iOS platforms and make the application ready for user interaction within a maximum of two seconds after startup under normal supported operating conditions.
- **Source Need:** UN-001
- **Priority:** High

### FR-002
- **Requirement:** The system shall require users to register and log in at app startup before accessing application functionality.
- **Source Need:** UN-009
- **Priority:** High

### FR-003
- **Requirement:** The system shall provide a unified user interface that presents and manages the app’s core modules, including news, live ticker, team and player information, stream links, notifications, and personalization features, through a consistent and directly accessible interface.
- **Source Need:** UN-002, UN-014
- **Priority:** High

### FR-004
- **Requirement:** The system shall allow authenticated users to select favorite clubs and preferred supported sports channels to personalize the content presented in the application.
- **Source Need:** UN-003, UN-010
- **Priority:** High

### FR-005
- **Requirement:** The system shall display current football news filtered according to the authenticated user’s selected favorite clubs and preferred supported sports channels.
- **Source Need:** UN-002, UN-003
- **Priority:** High

### FR-006
- **Requirement:** The system shall provide coverage data for supported national and international football leagues and competitions.
- **Source Need:** UN-005
- **Priority:** High

### FR-007
- **Requirement:** The system shall provide detailed information pages for teams and players and make them accessible at any time from within the application.
- **Source Need:** UN-006
- **Priority:** Medium

### FR-008
- **Requirement:** The system shall retrieve live match data from an external API and display live results and match events for users’ favorite teams through an integrated live ticker module.
- **Source Need:** UN-004
- **Priority:** High

### FR-009
- **Requirement:** The system shall continuously update the live ticker display with current match data as new live data is received from the external API.
- **Source Need:** UN-004
- **Priority:** High

### FR-010
- **Requirement:** The system shall display eligible external live stream links for matches directly in the application when the corresponding live broadcast has begun.
- **Source Need:** UN-007
- **Priority:** High

### FR-011
- **Requirement:** The system shall display live stream links only when broadcast rights metadata confirms that the stream is permitted in the user’s country.
- **Source Need:** UN-008
- **Priority:** High

### FR-012
- **Requirement:** The system shall allow users to manually activate notifications for their selected favorite teams.
- **Source Need:** UN-011
- **Priority:** High

### FR-013
- **Requirement:** The system shall send notifications about news and live results only for the user’s selected favorite teams when the user has activated notifications.
- **Source Need:** UN-011
- **Priority:** High

### FR-014
- **Requirement:** The system shall allow users to share supported news items and match reports through the mobile device’s social sharing capabilities directly from the application.
- **Source Need:** UN-012
- **Priority:** Medium

### FR-015
- **Requirement:** The system shall remain usable during limited network coverage or temporary loss of connectivity by allowing access to available application interface components and previously loaded content.
- **Source Need:** UN-013
- **Priority:** High

### FR-016
- **Requirement:** The system shall support up to 100,000 simultaneous users during peak match-day usage without loss of core application performance.
- **Source Need:** UN-015
- **Priority:** High

### FR-017
- **Requirement:** The system shall process users’ personal data, including account data, preferences, and notification settings, in compliance with GDPR.
- **Source Need:** UN-016
- **Priority:** High

### FR-018
- **Requirement:** The system shall keep the user interface and application modules operational and structurally consistent when external server data is updated.
- **Source Need:** UN-014
- **Priority:** Medium-- The app must allow users to individually select and display current football news of their favorite team from preferred sports channels.
- The app must allow users to view live results of their favorite teams in real time via a live ticker.
- The app must allow users to view league tables and statistics from current as well as past seasons.
- The app must provide users with detailed team and player information that can be accessed at any time.
- As soon as a live match begins the app must allow users to access live stream links from providers such as DAZN or Sky as long as the broadcast rights are valid.
- The app must allow users to register easily and log in directly from the start page.
- The app must allow users to personalize their experience by following their favorite teams and leagues.
- The app must allow users to select favorite teams and national teams to receive push notifications about news and updates.
- The app must allow users to receive push notifications about news or results of their favorite teams.
- The app must allow users to share news and match reports directly via social media.
- The live ticker module must allow users to retrieve and display live data.
- The app must allow users to access live match results through the user interface directly.
- The user interface must allow users to view and manage content and modules together.
- The registration system must allow the registration process to be carried out quickly and easily.
- The notification system must allow the app to send users information about current events once activated.-create_functional_req_geval]

metricsData.name: Functional Requirements Coverage & Quality [GEval]
metricsData.reason: The response covers most expected capabilities, including registration/login, personalized football news, live ticker with live results, team/player information, live stream links with rights checks, push notifications, social sharing, and a unified UI. However, it omits the expected ability to view league tables and statistics from current and past seasons, and it does not clearly cover following leagues or national teams for notifications. Several items introduce unsupported or non-functional details such as Android/iOS availability, two-second startup, offline usability, 100,000 simultaneous users, GDPR, and external API specifics. Some requirements are also broad or bundled, reducing atomicity.

testCases.name:
test_geval_requirements[Extract non-functional requirements-# 3. Non-Functional Requirements

### NFR-001
- **Requirement:** The system shall load and be fully ready for user interaction within a maximum of 2 seconds after application startup on supported Android and iOS devices under normal operating conditions.
- **Source:** UN-001
- **Priority:** High

### NFR-002
- **Requirement:** The system shall update and display live ticker match data in real time with end-to-end data refresh latency low enough to present current match events continuously during active matches.
- **Source:** UN-002
- **Priority:** High

### NFR-003
- **Requirement:** The system shall remain usable during periods of limited network coverage and shall preserve access to core app functionality and previously retrieved content when connectivity is temporarily unavailable.
- **Source:** UN-003
- **Priority:** High

### NFR-004
- **Requirement:** The system shall support at least 100,000 concurrent users on peak match days without performance loss affecting core user functions, including news access, live ticker updates, and team information retrieval.
- **Source:** UN-004
- **Priority:** High

### NFR-005
- **Requirement:** The system shall display live stream links only when transmission rights are valid for the user’s country and shall prevent presentation of restricted streams where rights are not fulfilled.
- **Source:** UN-005
- **Priority:** High

### NFR-006
- **Requirement:** The system shall process all personal data in compliance with GDPR requirements, including lawful processing, data minimization, and protection of user privacy for registration, personalization, notifications, and account-related data.
- **Source:** UN-006
- **Priority:** High

### NFR-007
- **Requirement:** The system shall provide a user interface that enables users to access core information and functions directly and consistently across integrated modules on supported Android and iOS devices.
- **Source:** UN-007
- **Priority:** Medium

### NFR-008
- **Requirement:** The system shall maintain functional consistency of the user interface and internal modules despite updates received from external servers.
- **Source:** UN-008
- **Priority:** Medium

### NFR-009
- **Requirement:** The system shall support uncomplicated registration and login at application startup with a streamlined authentication flow requiring minimal user steps.
- **Source:** UN-009
- **Priority:** Medium

### NFR-010
- **Requirement:** The system shall deliver notifications about current events to users as soon as the notification function is activated and relevant subscribed events occur.
- **Source:** UN-010
- **Priority:** Medium

### NFR-011
- **Requirement:** The system shall undergo thorough pre-release testing and support processes to detect and resolve malfunctions before production release.
- **Source:** UN-011
- **Priority:** Medium

### NFR-012
- **Requirement:** The system shall support continuous evaluation of user feedback and app reviews to inform ongoing improvements to app functionality and service quality.
- **Source:** UN-012
- **Priority:** Low
-- The app must be available for Android and iOS devices.
- Once the app is started, its startup time must be less than or equal to two seconds.
- The display of live streams in the app must comply with the respective broadcasting rights in the country.
- Users personal data must be stored in compliance with GDPR.
- The apps session management must ensure that logged-in users remain logged in until they actively log out.
- The app must function reliably even with limited network connectivity.
- When the number of users reaches up to 100,000 simultaneously, the app must remain stable.
- After release, a support process must be established to quickly resolve technical issues.
- After six months of operation, feedback and user reviews must be analyzed to further develop the app.
- The app must include an integrated live ticker module.
- The app must include a user interface that is an integral part of the app.
- The live ticker module must be connected to the user interface through its own interface to display data.
- The live ticker module must communicate with an external server via an API to retrieve current match data.
- The external server must provide the app with current match data.
- The external server must be physically located outside the app environment.
- The app must include a user management system.
- The user management system must be connected to the user interface via its own interface.
- The app must include a notification system.
- All modules and the user interface must be fixed components of the app.
- The connection to the external server must be designed flexibly.-create_non_functional_req_geval]
